Pick 5.text: Nebraska Pick 5 is exciting, because it's unique to Nebraska. It's our game. All the proceeds from the game stay here, and all the winning tickets are sold in Nebraska, at Nebraska Lottery retailers.
Pick five numbers between 1 and 40 by marking a Nebraska Pick 5 play slip. Or tell the clerk you want a Nebraska Pick 5 quick pick.

Each play costs $1 and you can pick up to 5 different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for up to 84 consecutive drawings (12 weeks worth) when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.
Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 9:00 p.m. to 9:03 p.m. on drawing nights.

The winning numbers are announced Monday through Sunday in time for the ten o'clock news. Get winning numbers here, from nelottery.com, on your favorite radio or television station, at a Nebraska Lottery Lotto retailer, in your local newspaper, or on the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.

The jackpot begins at $50,000 and grows each time it is not won. The jackpot prize will be divided equally among multiple winners, and is paid in one cash installment. The set prize amounts are based on expected number of winners. In unusual circumstances, these prizes may be paid on a parimutuel basis, which will be lower than the published prize levels.
Winning a Free Quick Pick Play Prize

Matching two numbers wins a free quick pick play. The free quick pick play prize is for one (1) Nebraska Pick 5 quick pick play, which will automatically print after the ticket is validated. A free quick pick play prize will be good for the next drawing. You cannot pick your own numbers on the free quick pick play prize.

Millionaire for Life.text: Pick five numbers between 1 and 58 for your five white ball numbers by marking the top section of the Millionaire for Life play slip. Then, pick one number between 1 and 5 for your green Millionaire Ball™ number by marking the bottom section of the Millionaire for Life play slip, or mark the quick pick box on the play slip.

Each play costs $5 and you can pick up to five different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for consecutive drawings when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.
Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 9:00 p.m. to 9:03 p.m.
Review your play slip carefully before giving it to the clerk. Once printed, a ticket cannot be canceled. Check your tickets before leaving the store.

The winning numbers are announced Monday through Sunday after 10:15 p.m. (Central Time). Get winning numbers here on nelottery.com, use the Nebraska Lottery mobile app, or call the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.

There are two "For Life" prizes available in Millionaire for Life. To win the $1 million a year for life top prize, players must match all six winning numbers. The second prize of $100,000 a year for life can be won by matching all five white ball numbers.

"For Life" prizes can be paid as an annuity for the length of a winner's natural life, or as one cash payment. A minimum of 20 years' worth of payments is guaranteed with the annuity option. Payments could last longer based on the lifespan of the winner.

The "For Life" prize amounts may be split if there are multiple winners in accordance with the official game rules. In some cases, these prizes may be paid on a parimutuel basis and will be lower than these published prize levels.

Pick 3.text: Nebraska Pick 3 drawings are held seven days a week, Monday through Sunday. Drawing results will be released to the news media and the public by 10 p.m. each night.
Prizes in Nebraska Pick 3 range from $1 to $600. The odds of winning range from 1 in 4.12 to 1 in 1,000. In all, there are 9 ways to win.
Nebraska Pick 3 gives players the chance to not only select the numbers they wish to play, but also the opportunity to decide what type of play style and potential prizes to play for.

Players can first choose from four bet types; Straight, Box, Straight/Box or Combo. Each bet type costs $1. The bet type selected determines the possible prizes by matching combinations of the winning numbers.

Players will pick three numbers, each from a separate set of ten digits (0 through 9). The numbers can be unique, such as 1, 2, 3, or identical, such as 1, 1, 1. Plays with three identical numbers cannot be purchased with the Box or Straight/Box Bet types.
A standard Nebraska Pick 3 play, consisting of one set of three numbers and one bet type for a single drawing, will cost $1. Each bet type costs $1.

The three numbers selected will be played against the winning numbers drawn, according to the following four bet types. The 3 Way and 6 Way Box bets are determined by the numbers chosen for your play. For example, to play a 3 Way Box select two like numbers and one different number, such as 1, 1, 2.

Straight: match all three numbers in the exact order drawn-
(one prize level)
--exact order match--$600

Box: match all three numbers drawn in any order-
(two prize levels)
--6-way match--$100
--3-way match--$200

Straight/Box: match the numbers drawn in either exact or any order-
(three prize levels)
--straight match--$350
--six-way match--$50
--3-way match--$126

Combo: match 1, 2 or 3 numbers drawn in exact position within the order drawn-
(three prize levels)
--3 numbers in exact order--$100
--2 numbers in exact position--$8
--1 number in exact position--$1

Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 9:00 p.m. to 9:03 p.m. on drawing nights. You can pick up to 5 different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for up to 84 consecutive drawings (12 weeks worth) when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.

The maximum top prize liability for any single Nebraska Pick 3 drawing is $150,000 (the equivalent of 250 Straight bet $600 top prizes). In the event that a number combination is purchased so many times that the liability limit would be reached if that combination was drawn, the game system will stop accepting transactions for that combination for that drawing.

Pick 4.text: Nebraska Pick 4 drawings are held seven days a week, Monday through Sunday. Drawing results will be released to the news media and the public by 10 p.m. each night.
Prizes in Nebraska Pick 4 range from $60 to $6,000. The odds of winning range from 1 in 100 to 1 in 10,000. In all, there are 16 ways to win.
Nebraska Pick 4 gives players the chance to not only select the numbers they wish to play, but also the opportunity to decide what type of play style and potential prizes to play for.
Players can first choose from six bet types:

Straight: match all four numbers in the exact order drawn
Box: match all four numbers drawn in any order
Straight/Box: match all four numbers drawn in exact or any order
Front Pair: match the first two numbers drawn in exact order
Middle Pair: match the middle two numbers drawn in exact order
Back Pair: match the last two numbers drawn in exact order
The bet type selected determines the possible prizes by matching combinations of the winning numbers.

For bet types other than Front Pair, Middle Pair, and Back Pair, players will pick four numbers, each from a separate set of ten digits (0 through 9). The numbers can be unique, such as 1, 2, 3, 4 or identical, such as 1, 1, 1, 1.
For the Front Pair, Middle Pair, and Back Pair bet types, select two digits each from a separate set of ten digits (0 through 9). The two numbers can be unqiue or identical.
A standard Nebraska Pick 4 play, consisting of one set of numbers and one bet type for a single drawing, costs $1.

The four numbers selected will be matched against the winning numbers drawn according to the six bet types. The 4 Way, 6 Way, 12 Way, and 24 Way Box bets are determined by the numbers chosen for your play. For example, to play a 4 Way Box select three like numbers and one different number.
Plays with four identical numbers, such as 1, 1, 1, 1, cannot be purchased with the Box or Straight/Box Bet types.

rows: 4 Way Box (3 like numbers, 1 different number, any order)

MyDaY.text: MyDaY is a new Nebraska Lottery Lotto game with a calendar theme. Players can win up to $5,000 by choosing a six-digit date for each $1 MyDaY play.

Pick one two-digit number from 01 to 12 for the MONTH and one two-digit number from 01 to 31 for the DAY by marking a MyDaY play slip. To select the YEAR (last two digits only), mark one number from 0 to 9 for the first digit and mark one number from 0 to 9 for the second digit. Or tell the clerk you want a MyDaY quick pick.

You may only use date combinations that are valid based on the standard twelve-month calendar. Invalid months and days that will be rejected include: 02/30, 02/31, 04/31, 06/31, 09/31 and 11/31. February 29 will only be allowed for years that are divisible by 4, including 00.

Each play costs $1. You can pick up to 5 different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for up to 12 weeks worth of drawings when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.
Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 9:00 p.m. to 9:03 p.m. on drawing nights.

The winning numbers are announced Monday through Sunday in time for the ten o'clock news. Get winning numbers here, from nelottery.com, on your favorite radio or television station, at a Nebraska Lottery Lotto retailer, in your local newspaper, or on the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.

For each drawing of MyDaY, a liability limit has been set by the Lottery. When the maximum number of wagers has been placed on a specific date combination so that the limit would be met if those numbers were drawn, no further wagering will be allowed for that combination. You will be asked to select another date combination.

The maximum top prize liability for any single MyDaY drawing is $200,000 (the equivalent of 40 top prizes). In the event that a number combination is purchased so many times that the liability limit would be reached if that combination was drawn, the game system will stop accepting transactions for that combination for that drawing.

Powerball Xs and Os.text: Pick eight (8) different NFL team logos on the Powerball Xs & Os play slip, or mark the quick pick box.
Each play costs $5. Only one play can be purchased using a play slip. You can purchase the same teams for consecutive drawings when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.

Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 7:59 p.m. to 8:02 p.m. (C.T.) on Sunday nights. Any tickets purchased after 7:59 p.m. (C.T.) on a Sunday will be eligible for the next drawing date. Review your play slip carefully before giving it to the clerk. Once printed, a ticket cannot be canceled. Check your tickets before leaving the store.

Winning team logos will be announced every Sunday after 9:00 p.m. (C.T.) Powerball Xs & Os results are randomly drawn and not based on, determined by, or dependent on the outcome of NFL games. The drawing results are not based on the Powerball winning numbers. Get drawing results here (nelottery.com), from your favorite Nebraska Lottery retailer, the Nebraska Lottery mobile app, or on the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.

Powerball Xs & Os has a cash jackpot for matching all eight team logos drawn. No annuity option is available. The starting jackpot for the September 13, 2026, drawing will be $1 million. Subsequent starting jackpots will be based on weekly sales. Each time the jackpot is not won, the jackpot will increase by an amount based on sales for that drawing.
While Powerball Xs & Os™ offers set prize amounts for lower-tier prizes, payouts may be determined on a pari-mutuel basis under certain circumstances. Click here for more information.

Every Powerball Xs & Os ticket purchased is eligible to win special promotional prizes. Enter winning and non-winning tickets for promotional prizes using the Powerball Official app or powerballofficial.com up to 90 days after a Powerball Xs & Os drawing. The promotional prize program is not conducted by the Nebraska Lottery. Prizes, drawing dates and other information is available at powerballofficial.com.
The Powerball Official app is available on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

Powerball.text: You can choose how to collect your Powerball jackpot--30 annual payments (over 29 years) or one cash payment (present value*)--up to 60 days after you become entitled to the prize. The annuity option now gives players annual payments that increase each year--projected at 4 percent.

* if you choose cash, the present cash value is less than the advertised jackpot, which is based on
a 30-year annuity.

Pick five numbers between 1 and 69 for your five white ball numbers by marking the top section of the Powerball play slip. Then, pick one number between 1 and 26 for your red Powerball number by marking the bottom section of the Powerball play slip, or mark the quick pick box on the play slip.

Each play costs $2 and you can pick up to five different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for consecutive drawings when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.

Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 9:00 p.m. to 9:03 p.m. on drawing nights. Review your play slip carefully before giving it to the clerk. Once printed, a ticket cannot be canceled. Check your tickets before leaving the store.

The $1 Power Play option offers players the chance to play for enhanced non-jackpot prizes. A separate drawing will be performed to select the Power Play multiplier number (2, 3, 4, 5, or 10) for all prizes except the jackpot and the Match 5 prize. The Power Play multiplier number is chosen from a field of numbers according to the following frequency: one (1) number 10, two (2) number 5s, three (3) number 4s, thirteen (13) number 3s, and twenty-four (24) number 2s.

The 10X multiplier will only be available for drawings with advertised annuity jackpot levels of $150 million and below. The other multipliers will be in play regardless of the jackpot amount. The Match 5 prize is $2 million if the Power Play option is purchased.

The winning numbers will be announced every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday at 9:59 p.m. Central Time. Get winning numbers here (nelottery.com), from your favorite radio or television station or Nebraska Lottery Lotto retailer, in your local newspaper or USA Today, or on the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.
Adding Double Play to your Powerball purchase for an additional $1 per play gives you another chance to match your Powerball numbers for prizes up to $10 million.

If you have a Powerball ticket with Double Play, you play the same set of numbers for the main Powerball drawing and the Double Play drawing. Double Play drawings are held between 10:30 and 10:40 p.m. Central Time on Monday, Wednesday, and Saturday nights.
Tickets can be purchased with Power Play and Double Play for $4 per play. However, the Power Play multiplier will not apply to Double Play prizes.

Mega Millions.text: You can choose how to collect your Mega Millions jackpot - 30 annual payments (over 29 years) or one cash payment (present value*) - up to 60 days after you become entitled to the prize. The annuity option now gives players annual payments that increase each year - projected at 5 percent. * if you choose cash, the present cash value is less than the advertised jackpot, which is based on a 30-year annuity.

Pick five numbers between 1 and 70 for your five white ball numbers by marking the top section of the Mega Millions play slip. Then, pick one number between 1 and 24 for your gold Mega Ball number by marking the bottom section of the Mega Millions play slip, or mark the quick pick box on the play slip.

Each play costs $5 and you can pick up to five different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for up to 24 consecutive drawings when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.
When each Mega Millions play is purchased, a multiplier is randomly assigned that multiplies non-jackpot prizes won by 2X, 3X, 4X, 5X or 10X. The average multiplier value is 3X.

To calculate your prize, multiply the Prize Before Multiplier value in the drawing results chart by the multiplier value assigned to your winning play. The multiplier does not apply to the jackpot prize.

Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 9:00 p.m. to 9:03 p.m. on drawing nights. Review your play slip carefully before giving it to the clerk. Once printed, a ticket cannot be canceled. Check your tickets before leaving the store.

The winning numbers will be announced every Tuesday and Friday at 10 p.m. Central Time. Get winning numbers here, from nelottery.com, on your favorite radio or television station, at a Nebraska Lottery Lotto retailer, in your local newspaper, or on the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.

Pick five numbers between 1 and 52 for your five red ball numbers by marking the left side of the Lotto America play slip. Then, pick one number between 1 and 10 for your Star Ball® number by marking the right side of the Lotto America play slip, or mark the quick pick box on the play slip.

Each play costs $1 and you can pick up to five different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for consecutive drawings when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip.

Lotto America features a prize multiplier option called the All Star Bonus. Players may add the $1 All Star Bonus to have the chance to multiply prizes between $2 and $20,000 by two, three, four or five times. The All Star Bonus multiplier does not apply to the jackpot prize. The All Star Bonus number is chosen from a field of 32 numbers according to the following frequency: three (3) number 5s, four (4) number 4s, ten (10) number 3s, and fifteen (15) number 2s.

The winning numbers will be announced every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday after 9:15 p.m. Central Time. Get winning numbers here (nelottery.com), from your favorite radio or television station or Nebraska Lottery Lotto retailer, in your local newspaper or USA Today, or on the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.

2by2.text: Pick two red numbers between 1 and 26, and two white numbers between 1 and 26, or tell the clerk you want a 2by2 quick pick.

You can pick up to 5 different sets of numbers on each play slip. You can purchase the same numbers for up to 28 consecutive drawings (4 weeks worth) when you use the multi-draw box on the play slip. Multi-draws can be purchased for up to 12 weeks.
Tickets can be purchased from 5:00 a.m. to 3:00 a.m. (Central Time) any day of the week except from 9:00 p.m. to 9:03 p.m..
Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday
Drawings are conducted by the Multi-State Lottery Association.
The winning numbers are announced Monday through Sunday in time for the ten o'clock news.

Get winning numbers here, from nelottery.com, your favorite radio or television station, a Nebraska Lottery Lotto retailer, your local newspaper or USA Today, or on the Players Hotline at 1-800-224-LUCK (5825) or in Lincoln at 402-471-6139.

If you purchase a ticket for 7, 14, 21, 28, 35, 42, 49, 56, 63, 70, 77, or 84 consecutive Multi-draws, your ticket qualifies for the free 2by2 Tuesday feature in which all prizes won on Tuesday automatically double in value. Any Multi-draw selection that is not divisible by 7 is not eligible for the 2by2 Tuesday feature.
Winning a Free Quick Pick Play Prize

Matching one number wins a free quick pick play. The free quick pick play prize is for one (1) 2by2 quick pick play, which will automatically print after the ticket is validated. A free quick pick play prize will be good for the next drawing. You cannot pick your own numbers on the free quick pick play prize. If you win the free quick pick play prize on Tuesday from a qualifying 2by2 Tuesday purchase, you will win two free $1 quick picks.

* The maximum grand prize liability is $220,000 per Sunday, Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday draw, up to ten (10) grand prize winners of $22,000. The maximum grand prize liability is $440,000 per Tuesday draw, up to ten (10) grand prize winners of $44,000 each. If there are more than 10 grand prize winners in any one drawing, then prizes will be awarded on a pari-mutuel basis.
